wallpapers.title: Neon Tokyo Rooftop
wallpapers.author: Antigravity_Art
wallpapers.description: A stunning view of a rainy Neo-Tokyo street from a rooftop, featuring a cyberpunk girl with futuristic headphones. Beautiful reflections of pink and blue neon lights.

wallpapers.title: Floating Sakura Shrine
wallpapers.author: PixelDreamer
wallpapers.description: An ethereal floating island in the sky featuring a traditional Japanese shrine surrounded by blooming cherry blossom trees under a bright crescent moon.

wallpapers.title: Samurai at Sunset
wallpapers.author: RoninArt
wallpapers.description: A cinematic shot of a lone warrior standing on a mountain cliff, watching a crimson sunset. Cherry blossom petals blow gently in the warm golden hour breeze.

wallpapers.title: Rainy Lofi Bedroom
wallpapers.author: ChillBeats
wallpapers.description: A cozy, warm-lit study bedroom at night. Raindrops slide down the big window showing a soft cityscape, while a cat sleeps peacefully beside a glowing screen.

wallpapers.title: Enchanted Forest River
wallpapers.author: StudioNature
wallpapers.description: A mysterious forest path alongside a crystal-clear stream. Magical glowing mushrooms and plants light up the dark forest, with warm sunbeams breaking through the canopy.

wallpapers.title: Cosmic Mech Vanguard
wallpapers.author: GundamFan99
wallpapers.description: An epic mecha suit navigating a colorful nebula in outer space, surrounded by celestial dust, distant stars, and trailing bright thruster engines.
